design: 50/50 assignment-stratified historical random holdout; no model selection
primary_contrast: AIPW incremental visits per 1000 eligible customers: T-logistic top 40% minus expected random 40%
uncertainty: 2000 arm-stratified paired bootstrap replicates; reapply top-capacity rule; conditional on trained models; no training uncertainty
test_reuse: No tuning or selection. Exact reproduction permitted to separate output folder with same plan/data/code hashes.
power: Approximate HT policy-minus-random MDD using training arm rates and q(1-q), alpha=.05 power=.8; not exact AIPW power
licence: Unspecified; source downloader only, no public raw data
review_decision: 50/50 fallback chosen over cross-fitting to retain an independent confirmatory evaluation.
